from.place: Proof paragraph 2, the displayed coherent finite-coefficient mapping-complex adjunction before R lim. Technical presheaf-presentability input to the enriched localization/presentation argument: Space-valued Yoneda evaluation and density.

title: Space-valued Yoneda evaluation and density
statement:
Use the universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$, coherent functors, spaces, mapping spaces and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]; small means $\mathcal U$-small. Let $C$ be a small quasicategory, let $\mathcal S$ be the infinity category of small Kan complexes with their full coherent mapping spaces, and put $\mathcal P(C)=\operatorname{Fun}(C^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$. The Yoneda functor is $h:C\to\mathcal P(C)$, $h_c=\operatorname{Map}_C(-,c)$. For every $c\in C$ and $F\in\mathcal P(C)$, evaluation at the identity of $c$ induces an equivalence of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P(C)}(h_c,F)\simeq F(c),$$
natural coherently in $c$ and $F$. Moreover, for every $F\in\mathcal P(C)$ there are a small simplicial set $E_F$, a coherent diagram $p_F:E_F\to C$, and a colimiting coherent cocone $h\circ p_F\to F$. Thus its apex satisfies $F\simeq\operatorname{colim}_{e\in E_F}h_{p_F(e)}$. The diagram and cocone retain all transformations and higher homotopies; the assertion concerns space-valued presheaves, not just their sets of components.

source.place: Lemma 5.1.5.2 (evaluation corepresented by Yoneda) and Lemma 5.1.5.3 (Yoneda density), printed pp. 321-323. The small model for the indexing diagram is the right fibration of elements of a small-space-valued functor on small C. Read online (March 10, 2012 text), not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical result.
